subject: Marketplace surge protection and channel credit flow
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@orbitmed.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitmed.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden list-price delta - reseller margin impact (OrbitMed)

Hi Neha,

Quick note from OrbitMed procurement — last week's private offer adjustments in the AWS marketplace triggered an unexpected list-price jump for the Reserved Node SKU we purchased. Our reseller (CloudNexus) is pushing back because their margin goes negative on the first-month overage band.

Can you help clarify two things:
- Why did the list price change (ticket/technical reason is fine)?
- What short-term options do you have for preserving our channel's margin (credits, temporary passback, or a short-term private offer override)?

This is time-sensitive — CloudNexus is asking for a written flow they can present to their finance team by EOD tomorrow. I've attached the invoice excerpt showing the delta.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Head of Procurement, OrbitMed
(attachment: OrbitMed_invoice_Q1.pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@orbitmed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden list-price delta - reseller margin impact (OrbitMed)

Hi Asha — thanks for flagging and for the invoice excerpt. Sorry for the disruption; we did a scheduled SKU reindex last week and one of the list-price anchors for the Azure-equivalent SKU and the AWS Reserved Node SKU were updated to correct an old parity bug. That correction increased the list price for a small set of legacy SKUs — it was an automated artifact, not a billing error.

Two immediate options we can offer while we sort a longer-term fix:
1) Short-term private-offer override: we can issue a 90-day private offer for the same commitment volume at the pre-change effective list price. This preserves your committed economics and keeps CloudNexus margin intact.
2) Reseller passback credit: a one-time passback to CloudNexus equal to X% of the overage amount for the first invoice cycle while we reconcile.

I want to avoid pushing changes that impact recognition or committed baselines, so my preference is option (1) + a one-time goodwill credit for the invoiced delta. Can you confirm which path you'd prefer? If helpful, we can do a 30-minute call tomorrow and I can bring Jordan and Ben to walk through implementation and timeline.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 17:05 Asha Rao <asha@orbitmed.ai> wrote:
> Quick note from OrbitMed procurement — last week's private offer adjustments in the AWS marketplace triggered an unexpected list-price jump...
> (attachment: OrbitMed_invoice_Q1.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Sudden list-price delta - reseller margin impact (OrbitMed)

Neha / Jordan — looping finance/ops because this is a classic channel-margin rescue. Quick internal read:
- Root cause confirmed: SKU reindexing changed the anchor (no downstream tax/rebilling issue).
- Impact band: affects ~6% of OrbitMed's committed node hours this quarter; delta concentrated on overage bands.

Proposal (internal):
- Issue a 90-day private offer for baseline commit at the prior list price (no change to committed units).
- Fund a one-time passback to CloudNexus equal to 6% of the first invoice overage (customer-facing language: "channel protection credit"). Funding source: one-time marketing/partner credit (P&L approved up to $75k per event).
- Operations: Jordan to create the private-offer, Irene to sign off on invoice adjustment documentation and channel evidence. Ben will draft the customer-facing commitment memo.

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx (shows the 6% scenario and a conservative 9% scenario).

Irene — can you confirm if ops needs any extra evidence or if we can attach the invoice excerpt and the private-offer amendment to the DocuSign? Also, if finance prefers a smaller passback, call it out and we'll present both options to the customer.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx)

> On Tue, Apr 13, 2027 at 09:12 Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Hi Asha — thanks for flagging and for the invoice excerpt...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@orbitmed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Sudden list-price delta - reseller margin impact (OrbitMed)

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the quick response earlier. We discussed your case internally and below is a short mutual-action plan so CloudNexus and OrbitMed have something formal to present to finance.

Mutual action plan (summary):
1) Private-offer override: Redwood will issue a 90-day private offer that fixes the baseline unit price to the pre-change list price for the committed Reserved Node SKU. This preserves your committed economics and CloudNexus margin. Implementation ETA: private offer issued within 24 hours after OrbitMed signs the amendment.
2) Channel protection credit: Redwood will provide a one-time channel protection credit to CloudNexus equal to 6% of the first invoice overage amount (calculated on the invoice showing the delta). This will appear as a passback credit on the reseller invoice.
3) Evidence package: we'll attach the OrbitMed invoice excerpt + private-offer amendment to the DocuSign so CloudNexus has the paper trail for their AP/finance.
4) Follow-up: Operations (Jordan and Irene) will create the private-offer and the amendment. Ben will share the calculation and the credit memo language for AP.

Next steps for OrbitMed:
- Please confirm acceptance of the above (private-offer + 6% channel credit) by reply. 
- If OK, sign the attached amendment (I will send DocuSign with the private-offer attached).

I'll send the DocuSign link once you confirm. Attaching the draft memo we will include for the reseller and the proposed private-offer terms.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
(attachment: proposed_mop.pdf)
